The triplets at 2.81 ppm and 2.98 ppm with coupling constants of 7.1 Hz suggest methylene groups adjacent to each other, possibly part of an alkyl chain. The aromatic region shows signals at 7.17 ppm and 7.90 ppm, which are consistent with protons on an aromatic ring, likely a monosubstituted benzene ring given the integration of 7H and 2H. The combination of these data suggests a structure with an aromatic ring, a carbonyl group, and an alkyl chain. To further confirm the structure, I should check the IR spectra for functional group confirmation, especially for the carbonyl group.</thought>

The multiple peaks in the range of 3100-3000 cm⁻¹ are indicative of C-H stretching in aromatic compounds, supporting the presence of an aromatic ring. The peaks around 1607-1573 cm⁻¹ suggest C=C stretching in the aromatic ring. Given the NMR and IR data, the molecule likely contains an aromatic ring with a carbonyl group and an alkyl chain.
